body:
17 Nov 2026, P2-25 slices 2+3, PR #110 LAST ROUND (built, not walked; not deployed; still a DRAFT: the lead and the advisor read the new dry run first).
A. THE BACKUP IS NEVER PRUNED AWAY. A reviewer reproduced it on d6868f4: 3 copies named in the future (clock set back, end of DST, time sync), the fresh copy was the OLDEST of 4 by name, prune_backups removed it, repair() went on with a path that did not exist: no backup. Two layers. (1) Database.prune_backups needs protect= (the copy just taken + the last committed repair's): never candidates, counted inside keep. The reuse no longer picks the newest NAME: an attempt's copy is recorded (setting.textnorm_backup_pending, own committed write) and only that copy is reused, while it exists and begins like SQLite; the commit clears it together with textnorm_backup_used. Names are not trusted, mtime neither (same clock). (2) Inside the write transaction, before any write, the copy must exist, be non-empty and begin with the SQLite header, else NOTHING is written, ONE error line, the server serves, the next start takes a new copy. Tests red on d6868f4 (12 in test_keyrepair by behaviour, 6 in test_db by signature only); 9 mutations red against a green control (29 tests pass unmutated). docs/18 rewritten, cost stated (with a clock that went back an older spare can be kept instead of a newer one).
B. NUMBERS (200,000 synthetic refs, Python 3.12.13, code of 66735f1; the 3,394-ref copy in brackets): THE PLAN at every start 3.4 s (0.07 s) = what EVERY start pays; the plan of the first start 3.6 s; THE WHOLE REPAIR once (plan twice + the copy + the writes) 8.3 s (0.28 s). 9 s was never a per-start cost. A 200,000-ref Host waits 3.4 s at each start before the server listens. Slice-3 row counts are the fresh dry run: 16 refs damaged, 8 pictures voided.
C. N-34 (#111 merged, a830fac): main merged. Docs conflicts only: CHANGELOG (both kept; N-34's sentence 'Arabic, Cyrillic is skipped' is false from this PR, reworded) and the audit: main itself carried B-133, B-134, B-135 TWICE after #107 + #111; kept one of each with the newest content (B-133 = N-34's text + my Fixed sentence); B-136 mine, no clash; migration 0018 still free. N-34 CODE untouched. Tests rewritten to the real rule: two different Arabic songs vs a third Arabic hit: neither (title_or_version, key inequality), vs the recorded Latin hit: neither (artist); the hit named as song A is A and not B; Habibi + either Arabic suffix vs the Latin hit Habibi: three keys, no match; one still-refused kind: no letter or digit (emoji, notes, tatweel only, vowel mark, punctuation). Each row asserts survives_fold_whole is True and the keys differ. 6 mutations red against a green control. test_album_dryrun: its Arabic ref is now ASKED.
FOR THE LEAD (N-34 code, not changed): (1) FIRST: album_dryrun._slug and tools/record_catalogue_fixtures._slug are ASCII-only: a query with no Latin letter is named search_track_; replay: 'not recorded'; --live saves the first Arabic answer there and hands it to every later Arabic song (row none: a miss, not a wrong match). Report-only, does not block #110, but any album_dryrun --live run on a non-Latin library after #110 cannot be trusted until fixed (slug through the new fold or add a hash). It is the only private text fold in N-34's modules (checked by grep; test_fold_call_sites is a list, not a scan). (2) album_finder's docstring and the STOP-GAP(P2-25 skip-rule) comments still say the fold loses Arabic. (3) With era 1 an Arabic song whose only hit is Latin-spelled gets a REMEMBERED none: N-34's retry policy for none matters now.
